messages.subject: Confidential - senior exit (Group Ops Director)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We have a sensitive situation I'd like Whitfield Carter to handle. As part of the post-Helix/Greaves reorganisation we're restructuring the operations leadership and Geoff Hartnell's role of Group Operations Director is going to fall away. Geoff has been with us since 2009 and is 58. He's also raised a series of H&S memos over the autumn which his solicitor will no doubt point to.

He filed a formal grievance on 9 January. We'd like to explore an exit by agreement rather than a contested process. Can your team take this on? Karen Mensah (Group HR) will be your main day-to-day contact.

Richard

Richard Calloway
General Counsel, Bracken Group plc

messages.subject: RE: Confidential - senior exit (Group Ops Director)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Yes, we'd be glad to help. This is squarely in our wheelhouse. Tom Gallagher will lead day-to-day with Elena Marchetti supporting, and I'll supervise.

The combination of the protected-disclosure memos and Geoff's age does elevate the risk profile, so a negotiated exit is sensible. We'll get an engagement letter out today and a short risk note to you and Karen within a few days. Could you send us Geoff's service agreement, the three H&S memos and the grievance?

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
